original_test_intent: Confirm OAM_5 power telemetry is correct and consistently represented across BMC Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Under a documented steady operating state, map equivalent OAM_5 power channels, collect a synchronized bounded series, normalize measurement domains/units/windows and evaluate validity, range, variance and cross-source deltas.
manual_activity: Power owner approves the OAM_5 steady-state and transient/statistical rules and owns discrepancy disposition.
required_inputs: Approved steady idle/load state and settling time
Secure BMC/DUT tools and matching Web evidence
safety_requirements: Read only and do not add unapproved load
Verify OAM_5 identity and stable operating state
Keep the complete first valid series
Stop on invalid, stale, unmatched or excessive-variance data
agent_execution_scope: Collect full OAM_5 power series from every required surface
Compute only approved statistics and comparisons
Report anomalies without cherry-picking or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve state, transient and metric rules

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its OAM_5 Redfish scalar is relevant but insecure, incomplete and vulnerable to transient cherry-picking.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture a bounded synchronized OAM_5 power series across Redfish/IPMI/ROCm/Web after approved settling and compare equivalent statistics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_5 and all source interfaces remain in the original read-only 5/5-minute scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Retain every sample, state transition and timestamp, then apply the approved settling exclusion once and compare series statistics without selective retry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes a continuously varying power check reproducible and resistant to cherry-picking.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not create or validate a stress workload or external energy meter.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Short source timing constrains statistical confidence; acceptance limits must reflect the approved capture duration.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines when OAM_5 is steady and which transient exclusions and series statistics are permissible.
expected_evidence: Timestamped Web series or refresh captures
Logs, exclusions, dispositions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines OAM_5 cross-source power reporting; DeepSeek is only incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: State, oracle, tools and confirmation can be supplied.

review_improvement: Uses retained series and a preapproved transient policy so OAM_5 parity cannot be manufactured by selective samples.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU power contains short transients even during nominally stable work, while BMC and ROCm sample at different phases. Selecting one favorable pair or repeating until a match creates biased evidence. OAM_5 must retain the full first valid series, apply only a predeclared settling rule, and compare compatible statistics with sample timing visible.
